charts.title: Kepler-11 f: orbits around Kepler-11
charts.description: The orbits of Kepler-11's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Kepler-11 f highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Holczer et al. 2016 (2016ApJS..225....9H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HOLCZER_ET_AL__2016): P 46.68568857 d

charts.title: Kepler-11 f: its transit
charts.description: Kepler-11 f crossing its star, as Kepler recorded it: 17 quarters (1 to 17) of the Kepler pipeline's 30-minute light curves of KIC 6541920, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 18 minutes earlier to where Kepler measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 37 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 30-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on Kepler's dip, 18 min early; 30-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 12 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
